tracks.title: Buying stamps at the post office

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: すみません。切手を二枚ください。

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: はい。二枚ですね。お手紙は日本に送りますか。
turns.english: Certainly. Two, right? Are you sending the letter within Japan?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: はい。大阪の友達に送ります。
turns.english: Yes. I'm sending it to a friend in Osaka.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: わかりました。こちらです。

comprehensionPrompts: What does the customer ask to buy?
Where is she sending the letter?

tracks.title: Getting ready for a picnic

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 明日のピクニック、何を持っていきますか。
turns.english: What will you bring to tomorrow's picnic?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: パンとお茶を持っていきます。

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: いいですね。かばんは大きいですか。
turns.english: Sounds good. Is your bag big?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: いいえ、小さいです。でも、パンは入りますよ。
turns.english: No, it's small. But the bread will fit.

comprehensionPrompts: What food and drink will the woman bring?
Is her bag big or small?
Will the bread fit in the bag?
